description: Wenzl-bridge closed-form y_λ for the generic Markov trace. Uses fractional principal Schur specialisation s_{λ, X}(Q) with Q = q² and X = qz/(1 - Q + qz).  Numerical at arbitrary precision (default 100 dps); symbolic in q via sympy.
formula: y_λ = s_{λ, X}(Q) / Σ_μ d_μ s_{μ, X}(Q)  where s_{λ, X}(Q) = Q^{n(λ)} ∏_x (1-X·Q^c)/(1-Q^h), Q=q², X = q·z/(1-Q+q·z).
